criteria.reason: The whole document faithfully preserves Thursday’s four-team decision, continuing six-team preview, opt-in/default boundary, all test/support facts and limits, consent/switch-back, timeout dashboard and threshold/interval, approval, postponement and later review.

The decision and named readiness actions appear together before the supporting evidence. This preserves the source’s ability to support approval and conditional invitations; follow-up and the still-open default decision prevent automatic rollout.

Decision, evidence/limits and follow-up form a coherent briefing. The invitation-permission explanation reinforces the setting boundary at the action point; the evidence remains connected and the complete document avoids fragmented or laborious reading.
